Definition: to cremate, i.e. to be (near) of kin (such being privileged to kindle the pyre)
BiblicalUsage: çâraph — to cremate, to be near of kin — turns up in its single occurrence in Amos. It is a small word, and it stays in its own lane.
TheologicalSignificance: To me, çâraph is a small window into how precisely God speaks.
